item.text: The verification confirms the only automated test passes, but it covers a formatting helper only. Running the declared start command exits immediately because `express` is not installed in the workspace; even with dependencies present, the source has no `listen()` call and the static page contains no sign-in or handover UI. I’m recording these findings, plus the data-access and persistence risks, in the release review.
